title: 基础实验技能培训
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training Series/08_Basic Lab Skills Training.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training Series/08_Basic Lab Skills Training/src.py

points.K6: 用过的吸头退进收集盒
points.K10: 粗天平与分析天平分工
points.K16: 离心机转得快，用错会伤人
points.K26: 选最接近的两种标准液校准

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台前，台上摆着移液器、天平、离心机
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab bench with a pipette rack, a balance and a small centrifuge, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，学用九种基础仪器。
overlay: 新生入门：九种基础仪器的规范使用

shots.scene: 九个仪器图标排成三行
shots.prompt_en: Nine icons in three rows: a pipette, a pipette controller, a balance, a centrifuge, a pH meter, a buffer bottle, a fume hood, a water purifier and a hot plate stirrer. No people.
shots.narration: 用得准，更要用得安全。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一天进课题组，看着满台仪器发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student on his first day in the lab stares at a bench full of instruments, scratching his head.
shots.narration: 阿杰刚进课题组，第一天就要配溶液。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起移液器乱转旋钮，旁边天平门敞开
shots.prompt_en: The young male student twists a pipette knob at random while the balance doors behind him are wide open.
shots.narration: 移液器乱拧，天平门也没关。

shots.scene: 小研走过来，递给他一副手套和护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and hands him gloves and safety goggles with a smile.
shots.narration: 小研说：别急，一样一样学。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 先穿戴好，再从移液器开始。

shots.scene: 老周给几名新生介绍实验台上的仪器
shots.prompt_en: The older man shows the instruments on a bench to a few new students, including the young male student.
shots.narration: 这些是课题组天天要用的基础仪器。

shots.scene: 移液器架上一排大小不同的移液器
shots.prompt_en: A rack holding a row of pipettes of different sizes with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 移液器有大有小，各有量程。

shots.scene: 移液器按钮顶端的量程标记特写，空白
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the top of a pipette plunger with a blank range marking. No people.
shots.narration: 量程就标在按钮顶上。

shots.scene: 超出量程的移液器被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pipette with a volume dial pushed beyond its maximum mark, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要超出量程使用。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手转动移液器顶端旋钮
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand turns the knob at the top of a pipette. No people.
shots.narration: 转动顶端旋钮，调到需要的体积。

shots.scene: 读数窗里红黑两色的空白数字格
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a pipette volume window with three digit wheels, one red and two black, digits left blank. No people.
shots.narration: 读数窗里红黑数字代表不同位数，要会读。

shots.scene: 大号移液器配大吸头，小号配小吸头，连线配对
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a large pipette linked to a large tip box and a small pipette linked to a small tip box. No people.
shots.narration: 不同移液器，配对应的吸头。

shots.scene: 松垮掉落的吸头被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a loose pipette tip falling off a pipette, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 吸头要装紧，松了就换合适的。

shots.scene: 移液器按钮下压的两档示意，一档二档
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a pipette plunger with two stop positions marked by two arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 移液器有两档。

shots.scene: 按到一档，吸头浸入液面，松开吸液
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand presses the plunger to the first stop, dips the tip into liquid in a tube, then slowly releases it. No people.
shots.narration: 先按到一档排气，浸入液面，慢慢松开。

shots.scene: 按到二档，液体全部排出
shots.prompt_en: The gloved hand presses the plunger down to the second stop, and the tip empties completely into a tube. No people.
shots.narration: 排液时按到二档，把液体排干净。

shots.section_title: 用过的吸头退进收集盒
shots.scene: 按退吸头键，吸头落进收集盒
shots.prompt_en: A thumb presses the tip ejector button and the used tip drops into a rigid collection box. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的吸头，按键退进收集盒。
overlay: 用过的吸头退进收集盒

shots.section_title: 用过的吸头退进收集盒
shots.scene: 按键失灵时，戴手套的手取下吸头
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand pulls a used tip off a pipette by hand over the collection box. No people.
shots.narration: 按键坏了，戴着手套取下也行。

shots.scene: 小研把移液器的水打进天平上的称量舟
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student dispenses water from a pipette into a weigh boat on an analytical balance.
shots.narration: 怀疑移液器不准，可以称水检验。

shots.scene: 水滴图标等于重量图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a water drop with an equals sign and a small weight icon. No people.
shots.narration: 水大约一毫升一克，体积能换成重量。

shots.scene: 天平读数明显偏小，旁边一个拇指朝下
shots.prompt_en: A balance display with a blank low reading and a thumbs-down icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 设700微升，只称得541毫克，差太多。

shots.scene: 小研给移液器挂上停用牌，向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hangs a blank do-not-use tag on the pipette and tells the older man.
shots.narration: 立刻停用，报告导师送去校准。

shots.scene: 小研手持电动移液器，插上一支长吸管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student firmly fits a long serological pipette into a handheld pipette controller.
shots.narration: 一毫升以上，用电动移液器。

shots.scene: 电动移液器上下两个按键，上键箭头向上、下键向下
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a pipette controller with two buttons, an up arrow by the top button and a down arrow by the bottom one. No people.
shots.narration: 吸管插紧，上键吸液，下键排液。

shots.scene: 液体冲过吸管顶端，打湿滤膜的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of liquid rising too far up a pipette into the controller and soaking a small filter. No people.
shots.narration: 吸过头，滤膜一湿就不工作了。

shots.scene: 拆开前端，取出湿滤膜，换上新滤膜
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands unscrew the nose of a pipette controller, remove a wet filter and insert a new one. No people.
shots.narration: 拆开前端，换上专用的空气滤膜。

shots.scene: 液体用的针头滤器被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a syringe filter crossed out with a red X next to an air filter with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 液体针头滤器不能代替。

shots.scene: 部件晾干，按方向装回，吸水试用
shots.prompt_en: Plastic parts drying on a paper towel, then reassembled, and the controller tested by drawing water. No people.
shots.narration: 晾干、按方向装回，先试一试。

shots.scene: 小研向老周报告电动移液器还是不好用
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shows the older man a pipette controller that still does not work.
shots.narration: 还有故障，立即报告。

shots.section_title: 粗天平与分析天平分工
shots.scene: 大台秤和带玻璃门的分析天平并排
shots.prompt_en: A sturdy top-loading balance next to an analytical balance with glass doors. No people.
shots.narration: 天平分两种：粗天平和分析天平。
overlay: 粗天平与分析天平分工

shots.section_title: 粗天平与分析天平分工
shots.scene: 大重物压在分析天平上，天平开裂的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a heavy block placed on an analytical balance with crack lines, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 称重的东西，放分析天平会压坏它。

shots.section_title: 粗天平与分析天平分工
shots.scene: 小粉末放在粗天平上，读数问号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tiny powder pile on a rough balance with a question mark on its display. No people.
shots.narration: 称少量的，粗天平又不够准。

shots.scene: 称量舟和称量纸并排
shots.prompt_en: A plastic weigh boat and a square of weighing paper side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 一克以上用称量舟，一克以下用称量纸。

shots.scene: 小研关上天平门，按去皮键，读数归零
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the balance doors and presses the tare button; the blank display resets.
shots.narration: 放好容器，关门，去皮归零。

shots.scene: 小研用干净药匙一点点往称量纸上加粉末
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves and goggles, adds powder bit by bit onto weighing paper with a clean spatula.
shots.narration: 用干净药匙慢慢加，别加过头。

shots.scene: 天平门关上，读数稳定的打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: A balance with closed glass doors and a steady reading icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 关上门，等几秒，读数稳了再记。

shots.scene: 小研把药匙上多余的粉末倒回原试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tips the excess powder from a clean spatula back into the original reagent bottle.
shots.narration: 药匙干净，多余的可以倒回原瓶。

shots.scene: 天平盘上撒落了一些粉末
shots.prompt_en: Some powder spilled on a balance pan and the bench beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 称量时撒了，要马上清理。

shots.scene: 先取出称好的样品，再用小刷清扫
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student first lifts out her weighed sample, then sweeps the pan gently with a small brush into a dustpan.
shots.narration: 先取出样品，再把天平和台面扫净。

shots.scene: 清扫物倒入化学废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Collected powder is put into a labeled chemical waste container with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 撒落物按化学废物处置。

shots.scene: 镊子夹起标准砝码放进分析天平
shots.prompt_en: Tweezers place a standard calibration weight on an analytical balance pan. No people.
shots.narration: 天平也会变得不准。

shots.scene: 大小两个砝码，读数旁都打勾
shots.prompt_en: A small and a large calibration weight each with a balance display icon and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 用量程上下两头的砝码各称一次。

shots.scene: 偏差大的读数旁出现扳手和说明书图标
shots.prompt_en: A balance reading with a large error icon, next to a wrench and a blank manual. No people.
shots.narration: 偏差明显，按说明书校准或报告。

shots.scene: 粗天平和分析天平图标下各写着范围
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a top-loading balance and an analytical balance side by side with blank range tags. No people.
shots.narration: 重的上粗天平，轻的上分析天平。

shots.scene: 干净的天平和台面，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A clean analytical balance and bench with a sparkle icon and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 撒了就清，用完干干净净。

shots.section_title: 离心机转得快，用错会伤人
shots.scene: 台式离心机，转子旁画着高速旋转线
shots.prompt_en: A benchtop centrifuge with motion lines around a spinning rotor icon. No people.
shots.narration: 离心机转得很快，离心力很大。
overlay: 离心机转得快，用错会伤人

shots.section_title: 离心机转得快，用错会伤人
shots.scene: 损坏的仪器和受伤小人两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a broken centrifuge with a crack and a person pictogram with a bandage. No people.
shots.narration: 用错了，伤仪器，也伤人。

shots.scene: 小研在天平上称两支离心管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student weighs two centrifuge tubes one after the other on a balance.
shots.narration: 最重要的一条：配平。

shots.scene: 单数样品旁加一支装水的配平管
shots.prompt_en: Three sample tubes plus one extra tube filled with water as a counterweight, making an even pair. No people.
shots.narration: 样品是单数，就用装水的管子补齐。

shots.scene: 转子俯视图，管子两两相对
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a rotor with tubes placed in exactly opposite holes, linked by dotted lines. No people.
shots.narration: 管子放在正对面，不然会不平衡。

shots.scene: 小研盖上转子盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts the lid on the rotor before closing the centrifuge.
shots.narration: 盖上转子盖，万一漏了也不外溅。

shots.scene: 离心机面板上两个选项图标：g力与转速
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a blank centrifuge control panel with two option icons, one for g-force and one for spin speed. No people.
shots.narration: 先选按离心力还是按转速设定。

shots.scene: 设定时间、按启动
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger sets the timer and presses the start button on the blank panel. No people.
shots.narration: 再设时间，按启动。

shots.scene: 小研站在离心机旁看着面板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands next to the running centrifuge and watches the blank panel.
shots.narration: 守到它达到最高速再离开。

shots.scene: 转速归零后，小研开盖取出离心管
shots.prompt_en: The speed display drops to zero; then the female graduate student opens the lid and takes out the tubes.
shots.narration: 停稳了，再开盖取样。

shots.scene: 离心管底部的沉淀特写，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a centrifuge tube with a pellet at the bottom and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 看看沉淀是不是达到要求。

shots.scene: 转子盖放回，机盖关好
shots.prompt_en: The rotor lid is placed back on and the centrifuge lid is closed. No people.
shots.narration: 用完盖好转子盖，关上机盖。

shots.scene: 大离心管液面停在八成处
shots.prompt_en: A large centrifuge tube filled to about four fifths with a line marking the level. No people.
shots.narration: 大离心管和吊篮，只装八成左右。

shots.scene: 装满的管子在旋转中从盖缝漏出，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an overfilled tube leaking from its cap while spinning, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 盖子不是完全密封，装满会漏。

shots.scene: 天平、八成刻度、清洁布三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a balance scale, a tube filled to four fifths and a cleaning cloth. No people.
shots.narration: 配平，只装八成，漏了马上清理。

shots.scene: pH电极插在装保存液的小瓶里
shots.prompt_en: A pH electrode resting in a small bottle of storage solution next to a pH meter with a blank screen. No people.
shots.narration: pH电极平时要泡在保存液里。

shots.scene: 保存液干了，电极裂开的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an electrode in an empty dried-up storage bottle with a crack, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 保存液干了，电极会失灵，甚至损坏。

shots.scene: 小研往保存瓶里补加保存液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tops up the electrode storage bottle with fresh storage solution.
shots.narration: 发现干了，马上补加。

shots.scene: 取出电极，用擦拭纸吸干，用纯水冲洗
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands lift the electrode, blot it with a lab wipe, rinse it with a wash bottle of pure water, and blot it again. No people.
shots.narration: 用前取出，吸干，冲洗，再吸干。

shots.scene: 把少量标准液倒进小管，大瓶盖好
shots.prompt_en: A little standard solution is poured from a large bottle into a small tube; the large bottle is capped. No people.
shots.narration: 校准时，倒一点标准液到小管里用。

shots.scene: 电极直接伸进大瓶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an electrode dipped straight into the large standard bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别把整瓶标准液弄脏。

shots.section_title: 选最接近的两种标准液校准
shots.scene: 三瓶标准液，写着4、7、10
shots.prompt_en: Three standard solution bottles with blank labels in red, yellow and blue. No people.
shots.narration: 常用的标准液有三种。
overlay: 选最接近的两种标准液校准

shots.section_title: 选最接近的两种标准液校准
shots.scene: 目标pH落在两瓶标准液之间的示意
shots.prompt_en: A number line with three bottle icons, and a target marker sitting between the two nearest bottles. No people.
shots.narration: 选和目标pH最接近的两种来校准。

shots.section_title: 选最接近的两种标准液校准
shots.scene: 小研翻开空白的仪器说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank instrument manual next to the pH meter.
shots.narration: 具体步骤，按说明书来。

shots.scene: 电极头完全浸没在搅拌中的溶液里
shots.prompt_en: A pH electrode tip fully immersed in a beaker of solution spinning on a stir plate with a stir bar. No people.
shots.narration: 电极头完全浸没，溶液充分搅拌。

shots.scene: 按读数键，读数稳定的图标
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger presses the read button on a blank pH meter; a steady-reading icon appears. No people.
shots.narration: 按读数键，等读数稳定。

shots.scene: 两只滴瓶：一只向下箭头，一只向上箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two dropper bottles with blank labels, one marked with a down arrow and one with an up arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 加酸pH降，加碱pH升。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜，一滴一滴往烧杯里加，边加边搅
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and gloves, adds drops slowly to a stirred beaker while watching the meter.
shots.narration: 少量多次，每次都搅匀。

shots.scene: 调过头又来回加的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pH needle swinging back and forth past the target with many drops added, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 调过头再往回调，溶液里盐就多了。

shots.scene: 电极放回保存液
shots.prompt_en: The electrode is rinsed and placed back into its storage bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 用完，电极放回保存液。

shots.scene: 缓冲液瓶旁有一面盾牌挡住pH波动
shots.prompt_en: A buffer bottle icon with a shield blocking zigzag arrows that represent pH changes. No people.
shots.narration: 缓冲液能让溶液的pH保持稳定。

shots.scene: 彩色条形范围表，每条长短不同，空白名称
shots.prompt_en: A colorful bar chart of pH ranges with bars of different lengths and blank names. No people.
shots.narration: 但每种缓冲液，只在一段范围里有效。

shots.scene: 小研对着范围表挑选缓冲液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points to a bar on a blank pH range chart and picks a bottle from the shelf.
shots.narration: 按目标pH，选合适的缓冲液。

shots.scene: 缓冲液分子抓住金属离子的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a buffer molecule loosely grabbing a metal ion. No people.
shots.narration: 有的缓冲液会结合金属离子。

shots.scene: 阳光照在缓冲液瓶上，冒出小火花
shots.prompt_en: Sunlight shines on a buffer bottle and small spark icons appear inside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有的见光会产生自由基，干扰反应。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜，在通风柜前把视窗升起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and a lab coat, raises the sash of a fume hood.
shots.narration: 用危险化学品，到通风柜里做。

shots.scene: 视窗升过安全线，蒸气外逸的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fume hood sash raised above a marked safe line with vapor escaping, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 视窗升到安全高度，不能再高。

shots.scene: 视窗边的风向条被吸向柜内
shots.prompt_en: A small ribbon strip at the sash edge is pulled inward by the airflow, with inward arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 先看一眼：气流是向里吸的。

shots.scene: 没有气流、报警灯亮，小研去报告
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood with a flashing alarm lamp and a limp ribbon; the female graduate student goes to tell the older man.
shots.narration: 没气流或者报警，别用，马上报告。

shots.scene: 手在柜内深处操作，前沿画着一条深度线
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands work deep inside a fume hood behind a marked line some distance from the front edge. No people.
shots.narration: 在柜内至少6英寸深处操作。

shots.scene: 柜内堆满瓶子的图标被打叉，整洁的打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a fume hood crowded with bottles crossed out with a red X, and a tidy nearly empty hood with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里保持干净，别当储藏柜。

shots.scene: 两种化学品相遇冒烟的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two open bottles next to each other with a reaction puff between them. No people.
shots.narration: 东西多了，容易相互反应。

shots.scene: 后部风口被瓶子挡住，气流箭头断开
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of the back vents of a fume hood blocked by bottles, with broken airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 挡住后面的风口，吸力就会下降。

shots.scene: 超纯水机旁，三杯水对比，一杯带杂质点
shots.prompt_en: Next to a wall-mounted water purifier, three glasses of water, two with tiny impurity dots and one perfectly clear. No people.
shots.narration: 配缓冲液，要用超纯水。

shots.scene: 自来水龙头和蒸馏水瓶上的杂质点
shots.prompt_en: A tap and a distilled water bottle with small impurity dot icons. No people.
shots.narration: 自来水和蒸馏水，杂质可能干扰反应。

shots.scene: 小研把瓶子放进水槽，出水管插进瓶口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a bottle in the sink and puts the dispensing hose into its mouth.
shots.narration: 接水时，瓶子放在水槽里。

shots.scene: 台面上的瓶子溢水漫到仪器下的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bottle on a bench overflowing and flooding onto instruments, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 忘了关，溢出的水会淹坏仪器。

shots.scene: 纯水机显示屏，读数空白，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a water purifier display with a blank reading and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 接水时看一眼读数。

shots.scene: 读数偏低、报警灯亮，小研去报告
shots.prompt_en: The water purifier shows a warning lamp; the female graduate student reports to the older man.
shots.narration: 读数低了或者报警，报告导师。

shots.scene: 换下的滤芯标签上写日期
shots.prompt_en: A new filter pack with a blank label where a date is being written. No people.
shots.narration: 换滤芯，在标签上写上日期。

shots.scene: 瓶里放进大小合适的搅拌子
shots.prompt_en: A stir bar of suitable size drops into a bottle on a stir plate. No people.
shots.narration: 搅拌子大小要和瓶子相称。

shots.scene: 旋钮慢慢调高，再加入试剂
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand slowly turns up the stir knob, then adds powder to the swirling liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 转速慢慢调高，再加试剂。

shots.scene: 热板上加热的烧杯，旁边一个高温警示标志
shots.prompt_en: A beaker heating on a hot plate with a hot surface warning sign beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 在热板上加热液体，要格外小心。

shots.scene: 沸腾翻滚的水被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water bubbling violently on a hot plate, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不是要煮沸，就别加热过沸点。

shots.scene: 易燃溶剂瓶放进通风柜里的加热板上
shots.prompt_en: A flask of volatile solvent heated on a hot plate inside a fume hood, with an inward airflow arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 易挥发溶剂，只在通风柜里加热。

shots.scene: 深夜空无一人的实验室里热板还亮着，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hot plate glowing in an empty dark lab with a moon in the window, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 热板不要长时间开着，更不要过夜。

shots.scene: 热板过热冒烟起火的示意
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an overheated hot plate with smoke and a small flame. No people.
shots.narration: 无人看管，热板过热就可能起火。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着空白笔记本向老周请教
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the older man a question, holding a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 哪台仪器拿不准，就去问导师。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现移液器和天平图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a pipette and a balance.
shots.narration: 移液不超量程，称量关门、撒了就清。

shots.scene: 离心机和pH计图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a centrifuge with paired tubes and a pH meter with an electrode in a storage bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 离心配平对称，电极泡好、少量多次。

shots.scene: 通风柜和纯水机图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fume hood with inward airflow arrows and a water purifier with a bottle in a sink. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜先看气流，接水瓶放水槽。

shots.scene: 热板和导师图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a hot plate switched off at night and a supervisor with a speech bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 热板不过夜，有问题就问导师。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰在整洁的实验台前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye at a tidy lab bench.
shots.narration: 仪器用得准，实验做得稳，下次见！
